input: Owner-directed: replace owner approval for all CI changes with two tiers (priv- workflows owned; others policy-checked by a required ci-policy check).
task: Two tiers of CI: priv-*.yml owner-only, every other workflow policy-checked by a new required ci-policy check

doc_friction.issue: Names portfolio-pages.yml; updated to priv-portfolio-pages.yml here, but the rename touches agent-instruction files so this PR needs owner approval regardless.

deviations.why: Control-plane PR: left open for the owner's one-time approval instead of self-merging, as the owner's brief asked.
deviations.did: opened the PR, did not merge

deviations.why: Brief kept non-secret workflows unowned, but conflict-markers is a required check; an unowned required check can be edited to always pass, so it moved to priv- with its script.
deviations.result: ci-policy refuses unowned jobs that could report as a required check

goal: Drop owner approval for CI changes that cannot hand an agent a secret, write token or weaker merge gate
notes: Local verification: ci_policy_check passes on all 130 workflows (97 unprivileged, 33 priv-); control_plane_guard --check-coverage passes (31 samples); test_ci_policy_check 84 tests OK, mutation-checked; platform/ci workflow suites 691+ pass; publish-surface snapshot regenerated; devstats, setup, harness tests pass. run_workflow_locally --for-changes: remaining failures are pre-existing on main and untouched by this diff (machine-shop-guides VENTURE.yaml evidence/launch date, verticals JSON, pages catch-all count, hardware-bets dead links, deploy-concurrency finding on uitest, tofu not installed). Outcome partial until the owner approves and applies the ruleset. Holes found beyond the brief: required-check name squatting, cache/artifact poisoning into privileged jobs, script-dir module shadowing of the guard (now run with python3 -I), and unowned code run by privileged jobs (9 residual risks listed in agent-hardening.md).
